t.111-76-2.agn: Its harmonised classification was updated in 2022 (ATP18): toxic if inhaled, harmful if swallowed, skin and eye irritation. The classification applies to the pure substance; use sprays with ventilation.
t.111-76-2.pw.0: Its vapour is harmful when inhaled; use spray products in a ventilated room.
t.111-76-2.reg.clp: EU binding (harmonised) classification, CLP Annex VI index no 603-014-00-0 (ATP18): Acute Tox. 3 (Inhalation), Acute Tox. 4 (Oral), Skin Irrit. 2, Eye Irrit. 2.
t.111-76-2.reg.ulke.TR: Türkiye SEA Regulation Annex 6 (Official Gazette 10.12.2020), index no 603-014-00-0: Acute Tox. 4 (Inhalation), Acute Tox. 4 (Dermal), Acute Tox. 4 (Oral), Eye Irrit. 2, Skin Irrit. 2. Difference from the EU: different category: Acute Tox. (Inhalation) EU 3 / here 4; only here: Acute Tox. 4 (Dermal).
t.111-76-2.summary: A solvent from the glycol ether group.
t.111-76-2.what: Dissolves grease and dirt and helps the surface dry without streaks.
